limitations: Two saved Ctrip apps; no fresh-draft or full-task generalization.
Conservative uncached token-cost budget, not a requirement to spend CNY 3 in settled bills.
Next-request input/output reservation can stop an arm below the budget ceiling.
Classic and mini package context differently; this measures complete integrations, not a single isolated control-flow line.
Earlier virtual-command trials are integration diagnostics, not final evidence against upstream mini-SWE-agent.
Wall times include transport and recovery invocations; no official speed-ranking claim.
Local ARM64 is not the complete official x86_64 lifecycle.
Six incomplete direct streams have unknown usage/cost; two relay setup failures are confirmed not sent.
